description: A Head of Talent must appoint one employee as the peer climate liaison for an eight-week pilot and finalize the liaison's operating schedule, intake safeguards, and supervision arrangement.

shared_context.S1: The company is piloting a peer climate liaison role for eight weeks to give employees a neutral first contact for everyday collaboration concerns.
shared_context.S2: The liaison may receive concerns and connect employees with support, but does not investigate complaints or make disciplinary decisions.
shared_context.S3: Elena makes the binding appointment and approves the operating arrangements for the pilot.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal staffing review for the pilot, Elena asks the team lead, employee experience partner, and HR operations specialist to formally disclose their relevant input before the appointment is finalized, and records each disclosure in the staffing review.
shared_context.S5: Priya, Noah, and Tessa are the employees being considered for the liaison role.
shared_context.S6: The appointment record must verify any required qualification before appointment; a candidate cannot be appointed provisionally and complete that qualification later.
shared_context.S7: When a candidate has completed a required course, the completion can be verified by adding the completion record to the appointment record before the appointment is finalized.

PF1.text: Priya told Marcus directly that during the eight-week pilot she can provide liaison coverage only on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and that those are the only days she can reserve for the role; Marcus has not yet updated Elena because the staffing review is still being assembled.

PF2.text: Rina personally observed a prior unresolved conflict between Priya and Noah, including a failed attempt at a one-to-one resolution; she has not placed it in the pilot materials because no formal case was opened.

PF3.text: Devon confirmed in the current HR operations checklist that a peer climate liaison must have completed the six-hour active-listening course before appointment and must receive one supervised review each month; Priya completed the course, while Noah and Tessa have not, but the completion record has not been added to Elena's staffing packet.

decisions.coverage_days: string; record the days as Tuesdays and Thursdays or Tuesdays and Thursdays only
decisions.intake_arrangement: string; describe the liaison's general intake role
decisions.noah_intake_arrangement: string; record an alternate contact, alternative channel, or paired channel for Noah-related intake
decisions.noah_intake_uses_alternate_or_paired_cha: boolean; must be true when Noah-related intake uses an alternate, alternative, or paired channel
decisions.training_completion_record_added_before_: boolean; must be true when Priya's completed course record will be added to the appointment record before finalizing

acceptance_conditions: Priya must be appointed as the peer climate liaison.
The liaison's coverage must be scheduled on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
Noah-related intake must use an alternate contact, alternative channel, or paired channel rather than an ordinary one-to-one meeting with Priya.
Priya's completed active-listening course record must be added to the appointment record before finalizing.
Monthly supervised review must be required.
A commitment to schedule monthly supervised reviews must be recorded.
The settlement must explicitly record that Noah-related intake uses an alternate or paired channel.

content_checks.C2: decisions['coverage_days'] in ['Tuesdays and Thursdays', 'Tuesdays and Thursdays only', 'Tuesday and Thursday', 'Tuesday/Thursday only', 'Tuesday and Thursday only']
content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'supervision' and 'monthly' in c['detail'] and 'supervised' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF3' in credited_facts and 'PF3' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF3' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P3: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Priya's stated availability changes the coverage schedule to Tuesdays and Thursdays rather than an unspecified or generic weekday schedule.
The observed unresolved conflict between Priya and Noah changes Noah-related intake from an ordinary one-to-one meeting to an alternate contact, alternative channel, or paired channel.

The HR checklist changes the appointment to Priya, the only candidate who completed the required course, and changes the record and follow-up to adding her completion record before finalizing, requiring monthly supervised reviews, and recording a monthly supervision commitment.
